sources.observation: The garden side has an unbroken run of pale window surrounds beneath a dark mansard and low central heraldic pediment.
The recessed central court entrance has a pediment and arched doors. Paired wings project from the body, with raised pavilions and dormers.

limitations: This entry covers the principal Augustusburg Palace exterior. Window carving, heraldic sculpture, and the garden stairs are reconstructed at viewing scale.
